installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

# ============================================================
# AstraHost PM2 Egg - Installation Script
# Professional-grade setup dengan full PM2 support
# ============================================================

set -e

PRINT_INFO()  { echo -e "\e[1;36m[INFO]\e[0m $1"; }
PRINT_OK()    { echo -e "\e[1;32m[OK]\e[0m $1"; }
PRINT_WARN()  { echo -e "\e[1;33m[WARN]\e[0m $1"; }
PRINT_ERR()   { echo -e "\e[1;31m[ERR]\e[0m $1"; }
PRINT_STEP()  { echo -e "\e[1;35m[STEP]\e[0m $1"; }

echo ""
echo -e "\e[1;35m╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\e[0m"
echo -e "\e[1;35m║        AstraHost PM2 Pro - Installation              ║\e[0m"
echo -e "\e[1;35m╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\e[0m"
echo ""

# Update & install core dependencies
PRINT_STEP "Installing system dependencies..."
apt-get update -y -qq
apt-get install -y -qq git curl wget jq ca-certificates
PRINT_OK "System dependencies installed."

# Install PM2 globally
PRINT_STEP "Installing PM2 globally..."
npm install -g pm2@latest --silent
PM2_VER=$(pm2 --version)
PRINT_OK "PM2 v${PM2_VER} installed successfully."

cd /mnt/server || exit 1

# Clone repository jika bukan user upload mode
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" != "true" ]; then
    if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        PRINT_WARN "GIT_ADDRESS kosong, melewati proses clone..."
    else
        PRINT_STEP "Cloning repository from ${GIT_ADDRESS}..."
        if [ -n "${USERNAME}" ] && [ -n "${ACCESS_TOKEN}" ]; then
            git clone --depth=${GIT_DEPTH:-1} "https://${USERNAME}:${ACCESS_TOKEN}@${GIT_ADDRESS#https://}" .
        else
            git clone --depth=${GIT_DEPTH:-1} "${GIT_ADDRESS}" .
        fi
        PRINT_OK "Repository cloned successfully."

        # Checkout branch tertentu jika ada
        if [ -n "${GIT_BRANCH}" ]; then
            PRINT_STEP "Checking out branch: ${GIT_BRANCH}..."
            git checkout "${GIT_BRANCH}" || git checkout -b "${GIT_BRANCH}"
            PRINT_OK "Branch ${GIT_BRANCH} checked out."
        fi
    fi
else
    PRINT_INFO "User Upload Mode aktif, melewati clone."
fi

# Install Node.js dependencies
if [ -f package.json ]; then
    PRINT_STEP "Installing npm dependencies..."
    if [ "${NODE_ENV:-production}" = "development" ]; then
        npm install
    else
        npm install --production --prefer-offline
    fi
    PRINT_OK "npm dependencies installed."
fi

# Install package tambahan jika ada
if [ -n "${NODE_PACKAGES}" ]; then
    PRINT_STEP "Installing extra packages: ${NODE_PACKAGES}"
    npm install ${NODE_PACKAGES}
    PRINT_OK "Extra packages installed."
fi

# Buat ecosystem.config.js default jika belum ada
if [ ! -f ecosystem.config.js ] && [ ! -f ecosystem.config.cjs ]; then
    PRINT_STEP "Generating default ecosystem.config.js..."

    # Deteksi main file
    MAIN_FILE=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(p.main||'index.js')}catch(e){console.log('index.js')}" 2>/dev/null || echo "index.js")
    APP_NAME=$(node -e "try{const p=require('./package.json');console.log(p.name||'app')}catch(e){console.log('app')}" 2>/dev/null || echo "app")

    cat > ecosystem.config.js << ECOSYSTEM_EOF
// ============================================================
// PM2 Ecosystem Configuration - Generated by AstraHost
// Docs: https://pm2.keymetrics.io/docs/usage/application-declaration/
// ============================================================

module.exports = {
  apps: [
    {
      // --- Identity ---
      name: '${APP_NAME}',
      script: '${MAIN_FILE}',

      // --- Instances & Clustering ---
      instances: 1,            // 'max' untuk cluster mode (multi-core)
      exec_mode: 'fork',       // 'cluster' untuk load balancing multi-instance

      // --- Auto Restart ---
      autorestart: true,
      watch: false,            // set true untuk watch file changes (dev only)
      ignore_watch: ['node_modules', 'logs', 'sessions', 'auth'],

      // --- Memory Management ---
      max_memory_restart: '${MAX_MEMORY:-512}M',

      // --- Restart Strategy ---
      restart_delay: ${RESTART_DELAY:-3000},     // delay sebelum restart (ms)
      max_restarts: ${MAX_RESTARTS:-10},          // max restart dalam window
      min_uptime: '${MIN_UPTIME:-5s}',           // min uptime agar dianggap stable

      // --- Environment ---
      env: {
        NODE_ENV: '${NODE_ENV:-production}',
        TZ: '${TZ:-Asia/Jakarta}',
      },
      env_development: {
        NODE_ENV: 'development',
        DEBUG: '*',
      },

      // --- Logging ---
      out_file: './logs/pm2-out.log',
      error_file: './logs/pm2-err.log',
      log_date_format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Z',
      merge_logs: true,

      // --- Graceful Shutdown ---
      kill_timeout: ${KILL_TIMEOUT:-5000},      // waktu tunggu sebelum force kill (ms)
      listen_timeout: 5000,
      shutdown_with_message: false,
    }
  ]
};
ECOSYSTEM_EOF
    PRINT_OK "ecosystem.config.js generated at /mnt/server/ecosystem.config.js"
else
    PRINT_INFO "ecosystem.config.js already exists, skipping generation."
fi

# Buat folder logs
mkdir -p /mnt/server/logs
PRINT_OK "Log directory created at /mnt/server/logs"

PRINT_OK ""
echo -e "\e[1;32m╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗\e[0m"
echo -e "\e[1;32m║          Installation Completed Successfully!        ║\e[0m"
echo -e "\e[1;32m╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝\e[0m"
echo ""
exit 0

variables.name: 📦 Git Repository URL
variables.description: URL repository Git. Contoh: https://github.com/user/bot.git | Kosongkan jika User Upload Mode = true

variables.name: 🌿 Git Branch
variables.description: Branch yang akan di-checkout. Contoh: main, master, dev. Kosongkan untuk default.

variables.name: 🔢 Git Clone Depth
variables.description: Depth shallow clone. 1 = hanya commit terbaru (lebih cepat). 0 = full history.

variables.name: 👤 Git Username
variables.description: Username GitHub/GitLab untuk private repository (opsional).

variables.name: 🔑 Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal Access Token untuk private repository (opsional). Jangan bagikan ke siapapun!

variables.name: 📤 User Upload Mode
variables.description: true = upload file manual tanpa clone git | false = clone dari GIT_ADDRESS

variables.name: ⚙️ PM2 App Name
variables.description: Nama proses PM2. Gunakan untuk pm2 logs, pm2 restart, dll. Hanya huruf, angka, dan dash.

variables.name: 📄 PM2 Startup Script / Entry Point
variables.description: File utama untuk dijalankan. Contoh: index.js, src/bot.js, dist/app.js. Diabaikan jika ecosystem.config.js ada.

variables.name: 🏗️ PM2 Exec Mode
variables.description: fork = single process (default) | cluster = multi-instance load balancing (butuh kode cluster-safe)

variables.name: 🔢 PM2 Instances
variables.description: Jumlah instance (hanya efektif di cluster mode). 1 = single | max = semua CPU core

variables.name: 🧠 Max Memory Restart (MB)
variables.description: Bot akan auto-restart jika RAM melewati batas ini. Contoh: 256 = 256MB, 512 = 512MB

variables.name: 🔄 Max Restarts
variables.description: Jumlah maksimum restart sebelum PM2 menyerah (dalam 60 detik). 0 = unlimited

variables.name: ⏱️ Restart Delay (ms)
variables.description: Delay sebelum PM2 me-restart proses yang crash (milidetik). Default: 3000 = 3 detik

variables.name: ⏳ Min Uptime (stable threshold)
variables.description: Durasi minimum proses harus berjalan agar dianggap stable. Contoh: 5s, 10s, 1m

variables.name: 🔪 Kill Timeout (ms)
variables.description: Waktu tunggu graceful shutdown sebelum force kill. Default: 5000 = 5 detik

variables.name: 🌍 Node Environment
variables.description: Mode environment Node.js. production = optimal | development = debug mode (verbose log)

variables.name: 🕐 Timezone
variables.description: Timezone untuk proses. Contoh: Asia/Jakarta, Asia/Singapore, UTC

variables.name: 📦 Extra npm Packages
variables.description: Package npm tambahan yang diinstall saat server start. Contoh: ffmpeg-static sharp canvas

variables.name: 🔃 Auto Update via Git
variables.description: 1 = git pull + npm install otomatis saat server start | 0 = nonaktif

variables.name: 📺 Enable XVFB (Headless Display)
variables.description: 1 = aktifkan virtual display untuk Puppeteer/Chromium | 0 = nonaktif

variables.name: 📜 PM2 Log Rotation (lines)
variables.description: Jumlah baris maksimum per log file sebelum dirotasi. 0 = nonaktif. Contoh: 5000

variables.name: 🔗 Use ecosystem.config.js
variables.description: 1 = gunakan ecosystem.config.js (lebih powerful) | 0 = gunakan PM2_SCRIPT langsung
